A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Variational Speculative Decoding work. Their complete 22-page contents, including Appendices A–F, support reliable comparison of text, equations, figures and tables.

before.justification: v4 reports original decoding evaluations and ablations in Section 5, Tables 1–5, and additional VSD(KL) experiments in Appendix D, Table 7.

after.justification: v5 retains the original speedup, acceptance-length and ablation results in Section 5 and Appendix D.

M1.justification: The VSD objective, Monte Carlo EM procedure, oracle, ARW and CAR components remain identical in Section 4 and Appendix B. The Appendix D VSD(KL) variant is also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same training datasets, three language benchmarks and six multimodal benchmarks. Section 5 and Appendices D/F contain no coverage changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within Tables 1–3 and 7, including the EAGLE-3 language comparisons, MSD/ViSpec multimodal comparisons and GRIFFIN/HASS compatibility evaluations.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendices D/F retain the same model configurations, training budgets, decoding temperatures, batch sizes, tree settings and speedup/acceptance-length metrics.

E4.justification: The greedy-path analysis in Figure 1, ARW/CAR and proposal-count ablations in Table 4, batch-size study in Table 5 and KL-variant analysis in Appendix D are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report averages over three independent runs in Appendices D/F. Run-count disclosures and uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Figure 1 and Tables 1–5 and 7 retain the same results. For example, Table 1 reports EAGLE-3+VSD average speedup 4.22 and acceptance length 7.00 for LLaMA-3.1-Instruct-8B at temperature 0 in both versions.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, ELBO derivation, Theorems 1–3 in Section 4.4 and their Appendix C proofs are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same variational-training contribution, theoretical efficiency claims and language/multimodal performance claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations involving draft–target alignment, longer-horizon tasks and decoding temperature are retained. Section 6 preserves the limitations concerning proposal counts beyond 40 and extension to speech.

D1.justification: Implementation instructions, hyperparameters, hardware, training schedules and use of publicly released models/code remain unchanged in Section 5 and Appendices D/F.

R1.justification: The cited works and reference entries are unchanged. Section 2 retains the same positioning of VSD as complementary to existing speculative-decoding methods.

P1.justification: The second affiliation expands from 'Ant Group' to 'Ant Digital Technologies, Ant Group'. The acknowledgement replaces 'Ant Group' with 'Ant Digital Technologies, Ant Group Research Fund'. The version/date stamp changes; scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The longer affiliation and acknowledgement produce limited column and page reflow on pages 1–3 and 10. Figure 1 and Tables 1–7 retain their content and design; all remaining pages render identically.

improvement.justification: v5 updates institutional and funding attribution with slight layout reflow. Methods, proofs, empirical evidence, limitations and reproducibility information are unchanged, including the appendices. These administrative edits do not materially alter readability or overall paper quality.
